title: SGPC: Safety-Guiding Policy Constraint for Stable Off-Policy Safe Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.30265v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Off-policy safe reinforcement learning (RL) faces a challenging trade-off between task optimality and constraint feasibility. In primal-dual methods, the coupled optimization of cumulative reward and constraint penalties through adaptive Lagrange multipliers may induce oscillatory policy updates near the safety boundary and amplify the effect of unreliable reward estimates outside the safe set. To address these issues, we formulate a new constrained optimization problem (COP) for safe RL by introducing a Safety-Guiding Policy (SGP) and a corresponding Safety-Guiding Policy Constraint (SGPC). The proposed COP augments the standard COP in safe RL with a conditional safety-guidance constraint. During actor updates, the current actor is evaluated using the learned cost critic. translated_title: SGPC：面向稳定离策略安全强化学习的安全引导策略约束
translated_abstract: 离策略安全强化学习（RL）面临着任务最优性与约束可行性之间的艰难权衡。在原始-对偶方法中，通过自适应拉格朗日乘子对累积奖励和约束惩罚进行耦合优化，可能导致策略在安全边界附近产生振荡性更新，并放大安全集之外不可靠奖励估计的影响。为解决这些问题，我们通过引入安全引导策略（SGP）和相应的安全引导策略约束（SGPC），为安全强化学习构建了一个新的约束优化问题（COP）。所提出的COP在安全强化学习的标准COP基础上增加了一个条件性的安全引导约束。在执行者（actor）更新过程中，利用学习到的代价评论家（cost critic）对当前执行者进行评估。如果预测其位于安全集之外，SGP会提供一个邻近的低代价训练参考，SGPC则引导执行者的优化朝向该参考。一旦……（摘要截断）
tldr: 该论文提出安全引导策略约束（SGPC），在策略被预测超出安全集时提供邻近的低代价训练参考来引导策略优化，从而稳定离策略安全强化学习、缓解原始-对偶方法中的振荡更新问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Safety-Guiding Policy Constraint (SGPC), which provides a nearby lower-cost training reference to guide actor optimization when the policy is predicted to be outside the safe set, thereby stabilizing off-policy safe RL and mitigating oscillatory policy updates in primal-dual methods.
